prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished original painted dark fantasy vignette for the MAIN RULEBOOK of Warhammer Armies Project, The Game of Fantasy Battles. Match a collection of richly detailed realistically painted faction cover cutouts: tactile antique steel, gold, leather, cloth and natural anatomy. Subject: a dramatic compact battle between an Empire human general and a towering Chaos warrior. Left, the determined moustached Empire general in engraved Renaissance plate, red-and-white slashed sleeves and feathered helmet raises a heavy warhammer; right, the threatening Chaos champion in blackened plate with brass trim, horned enclosed helmet and torn crimson cloak braces with a huge rune-marked shield and sword. Behind the human, a short broad white-bearded dwarf with a runic axe and a graceful High Elf spearman in silver and blue join the defense. Behind the Chaos warrior, a hulking green tusked Orc with a crude cleaver looms as another threat. Arrange as an evocative ensemble battle illustration, two clearly opposed sides, readable silhouettes, five characters maximum. An ancient winged dragon arcs high above the clash, its complete wings folded into a compact arch, representing the magical world and broad scope of fantasy battles. Small irregular patch of broken stone and battlefield debris beneath. Strong diagonal movement and balanced triangular composition, restrained blue, red, gold and iron palette. Square canvas. CRITICAL: actual transparent PNG alpha background around the entire artwork and between silhouette gaps. NO rectangular scenery, sky, black backdrop, white backdrop, painted checkerboard or parchment. Sparse smoke dissolves into transparency. Leave generous clear transparent margin on all four sides, contain ALL wings, weapons and figures, no cropping. NO text, title, words, letters, logos, border, watermark. Not a miniature photograph, not a toy, not science fiction. Non-graphic battle, no gore.
